raw.english: The refined essences of the nectar melt into the letter vam at your heart, and this letter is the indivisible combination of your own thoughts and the holy mind of all the Buddhas and Angels.  Thinking strongly that this is happening--that it makes the letter blaze with even greater splendor and gives you extraordinary wisdom of bliss and emptiness--is the ecstasy of the holy mind.

raw.acip: LUS THAMS CAD YE SHES KYI BDUD RTZIS GANG SGO GSUM GYI SDIG SGRIB THAMS CAD SANGS KYIS DAG ,BDUD RTZI'I DVANGS MA RNAMS SNYING GA'I BAm YIG SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI NGO BOR MOS PA LA THIM PAS BDE STONG GNYIS SU MED PA'I YE SHES KYI RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN RGYUD LA SKYES SHING MNYES PAR BSAM,
raw.wylie: lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag ,bdud rtsi'i dvangs ma rnams snying ga'i baM yig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor mos pa la thim pas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes shing mnyes par bsam
raw.english: This nectar of wisdom fills every single corner of your body.  It cleans away each and every one of your negative deeds and obstacles, leaving you perfectly pure. Imagine then that the vam letter at your heart is in actuality every single Enlightened Being of the universe; the very essence of the nectar sinks into this letter, triggering within Them even more extraordinary realizations of the wisdom of undivided bliss and void.  See then that They are very, very pleased with you.

raw.acip: 'DI SKABS SKYON SBYANGS PA LAS BDUD RTZIR BSGYUR MA ZIN LA, DE'I STENG GI BAR SNANG NAS HE RU KA'I NGO BO H'Um DKAR PO YONGS SU GYUR PA LAS KUN DA LTA BU'I BYANG SEMS KYI RANG BZHIN GYI KHA tV'Am GA DKAR PO MAR GYIS BCOS PA LTA BU ZHU LA KHAD 'DRA BA MGO MJUG LDOG STE BDUD RTZI'I DBUS SU LHUNG BA GA YON SKOR LAN GSUM GYI MTHAR LTEM GYIS ZHU BAS RDZAS RNAMS NA BA MED PA SMAN, 'CHI BA MED PA TSE, ZAG PA MED PA YE SHES KYI BDUD RTZIR GYUR NAS BCUD DE DAG MDOG DKAR BA, RO MNGAR BA, REG BYA BSIL BA, NUS PA SHI NAS ZHAG BDUN LON PA'I RO'I KHAR SONG YANG GSO NUS PA LTA BUR GYUR PA NI YON TAN RTOGS PA,
raw.wylie: 'di skabs skyon sbyangs pa las bdud rtsir bsgyur ma zin la, de'i steng gi bar snang nas he ru ka'i ngo bo hUM dkar po yongs su gyur pa las kun da lta bu'i byang sems kyi rang bzhin gyi kha TvAM ga dkar po mar gyis bcos pa lta bu zhu la khad 'dra ba mgo mjug ldog ste bdud rtsi'i dbus su lhung ba ga yon skor lan gsum gyi mthar ltem gyis zhu bas rdzas rnams na ba med pa sman, 'chi ba med pa tshe, zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur nas bcud de dag mdog dkar ba, ro mngar ba, reg bya bsil ba, nus pa shi nas zhag bdun lon pa'i ro'i khar song yang gso nus pa lta bur gyur pa ni yon tan rtogs pa
raw.english: At this point the liquid is only purified of the imperfections; it has not yet become nectar.  Now in the space above there comes a white letter hung, which in its essence is Heruka.  It transforms, and from it comes a khatvanga staff that has the nature of the element of enlightenment which is like kunda.  The staff is white, as though it were made of butter, and seems almost about to melt. The staff turns on its head and falls into the middle of the nectar; it goes around three times to the left and then melts completely.  Now the things in the cup become the nectar of medicine, the end of all sickness; the nectar of life, the end of all death; and the nectar of wisdom, the end of all impurity. These essential fluids now take on a white color.  Their taste is sweet, and they are cool to the touch.  Their potency is as if they could be poured into the mouth of a man who was seven days dead and revive them.  This then is the step we call "realizing the fine qualities."

raw.acip: A'A:S BDUD RTZIR BSGYUR, AOm GYIS MANG POR SPEL BAR BSAM LA 'BRU GSUM LAN GSUM BRJOD NAS NA BA MED PA SMAN, 'CHI BA MED PA TSE, ZAG PA MED PA YE SHES KYI BDUD RTZIR GYUR PAS, BDUD RTZI KHA DOG DKAR PO RO MNGAR BA REG BYA SHIN TU BSIL BA, MYONG BA REG PA MTHONG BA TZAM GYIS SHI NAS ZHAG BDUN SONG RUNG GSOS NGES PA'I NUS PA PHUN SUM TSOGS PAR GYUR PAR BSAM,
raw.wylie: a'a:s bdud rtsir bsgyur, aoM gyis mang por spel bar bsam la 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod nas na ba med pa sman, 'chi ba med pa tshe, zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pas, bdud rtsi kha dog dkar po ro mngar ba reg bya shin tu bsil ba, myong ba reg pa mthong ba tsam gyis shi nas zhag bdun song rung gsos nges pa'i nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam
raw.english: The ah transforms the substance into nectar, and the om causes it to expand.  Imagine this, repeat the three syllables, and think that the substance has become the medicine of eternal health, the life of deathlessness, and the wisdom of the immaculate.  The color of the nectar is silver; its taste is sweet; and it is very cool to the touch.  Think that the liquid has become so miraculous that just through experiencing it--by either touching it with your finger or laying your eyes upon it--it most surely has the power to bring a person who has been dead for seven days back to life.

raw.acip: ZHAL GYI MCHU SGROS BIMPA LTAR DMAR PA, BIMPA NI RGYA GAR SKAD DE, BSGYUR NA GZUGS BRNYAN CAN, ZHES PAR 'GYUR, 'DI RGYA GAR NAS 'BYUNG ZHING, PHAL SKAD LA KANDHU RA ZER BA'I SHING THOG DMAR PO SHIN TU MDOG LEGS GSAL DVANGS PHYI ROL GYI GZUGS BRNYAN KYANG 'CHAR BZOD PA LTA BU ZHIG YIN GSUNGS,
raw.wylie: zhal gyi mchu sgros bimpa ltar dmar pa, bimpa ni rgya gar skad de, bsgyur na gzugs brnyan can, zhes par 'gyur, 'di rgya gar nas 'byung zhing, phal skad la kandhu ra zer ba'i shing thog dmar po shin tu mdog legs gsal dvangs phyi rol gyi gzugs brnyan kyang 'char bzod pa lta bu zhig yin gsungs
raw.english: The Angel's lips are red as the bimba.  The word bimba is Sanskrit, and translates into Tibetan as "the one with the reflection."  It is said that this refers to a fruit that comes from India, one that is commonly referred to as the kandhura.  The kandhura has a fine, vivid crimson color, and its surface is so bright that you can see your reflection in it.

raw.acip: KHYAD PAR MA'I KHAMS DMAR PO DES LUS BSKYED PA YIN TE, DE SKABS ZLA MTSAN MI 'DZAG PA'ANG BU'I LTE BAR KHRAG 'GRO BA'I LAM 'ONG BA DANG, MNGAL KHRAG GI DVANGS MA DE LTE BAR GNAS PA DE LA AA THUNG NGAM NANG GI RDO RJE PHAG MO ZHES PA DE'I RNAM 'GYUR LA BRTEN NAS PHYI'I RNAL 'BYOR MA GSUM RIM BZHIN 'DU BA DANG,
raw.wylie: khyad par ma'i khams dmar po des lus bskyed pa yin te, de skabs zla mtshan mi 'dzag pa'ang bu'i lte bar khrag 'gro ba'i lam 'ong ba dang, mngal khrag gi dvangs ma de lte bar gnas pa de la aa thung ngam nang gi rdo rje phag mo zhes pa de'i rnam 'gyur la brten nas phyi'i rnal 'byor ma gsum rim bzhin 'du ba dang
raw.english: Most especially it is the red element of the mother which creates this body.  The reason why her monthly period stops during this time is because a pathway is created inside of her body which allows this blood to pass into her child's navel.  The nutritive essence of the blood from her womb stays in the child's navel, and is then given the name of the "dagger of the short ah," or "the inner Diamond Sow."  Due to this manifestation, the outer three Angels of Diamond are gathered in, one by one.

raw.acip: DBU MA KHYAD CHOS GSUM LDAN ZHES BYA BA DRANGS SHING 'DRONGS PA CHU SHING GI SDONG PO LTA BU, GSAL SHING DVANGS PA TIL MAR GYI MAR ME LTA BU, 'JAM ZHING MNYEN PA PADMA'I 'DAB MA LTA BU, DE'I STENG DU DMAR ZHING SNUM PA RGYA SKYEGS KYI KHU BA LTA BU BSNAN PA BZHI LDAN DU BZHED PA'ANG YOD,
raw.wylie: dbu ma khyad chos gsum ldan zhes bya ba drangs shing 'drongs pa chu shing gi sdong po lta bu, gsal shing dvangs pa til mar gyi mar me lta bu, 'jam zhing mnyen pa padma'i 'dab ma lta bu, de'i steng du dmar zhing snum pa rgya skyegs kyi khu ba lta bu bsnan pa bzhi ldan du bzhed pa'ang yod
raw.english: The central channel is said to have three qualities.  It is perfectly straight and runs erect like a rod.  It is clear and translucent like a sesame oil flame.  It is soft and pliable like the petal of a lotus flower.  On top of these some people add a fourth quality--that it is red and glistening like the sap from a {@???} plant.

raw.acip: STONG PA NYID DU GYUR, STONG PA'I NGANG LAS RANG GI MDUN DU B+H+RUm LAS RIN PO CHE'I SNOD YANGS SHING RGYA CHE BA'I NANG DU, AOm LAS GTOR MA DVANGS SHING THOGS PA MED PA YE SHES KYI BDUD RTZI'I RGYA MTSO CHEN PO GYUR,
raw.wylie: stong pa nyid du gyur, stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du b+h+ruM las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du, aoM las gtor ma dvangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur
raw.english: Into emptiness it transforms. Out of a state of emptiness There appears before me A letter bhrum, Which transforms Into a jeweled vessel, Vast and wide. Within the vessel Comes a letter om, Which transforms into The torma cake, Clear as crystal Ineffable to the touch. And then this becomes A boundless sea Of the deathless nectar Of wisdom.

raw.acip: DUM SKYES MA'I LJAGS 'OD ZER GYI SPU GUS GTOR MA'I BCUD DVANGS TE GSOL BAR GYUR,
raw.wylie: dum skyes ma'i ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud dvangs te gsol bar gyur
raw.english: The holy tongue Of the Lady of Pieces, Khandarohi herself, Becomes a straw of light; She partakes Of the heart, Of the very essence, Of the offering cake.

raw.acip: KHA NUB DANG, GZHOGS G-YAS PHABS, LAG PA G-YAS PA 'GRAM PA G-YAS PA'I 'OG DANG, G-YON PA RLA G-YON PA'I KHAR BZHAG, RKANG PA BRKYANGS BSKUMS CI RIGS BYAS PA SENGGE'I NYAL STABS KYIS NYAL ZHING, THAMS CAD DVANGS GSAL 'OD KYI RANG BZHIN CAN DU GNYID BSAD RES KYIS GSAL 'DEBS PA YIN LA,
raw.wylie: kha nub dang, gzhogs g-yas phabs, lag pa g-yas pa 'gram pa g-yas pa'i 'og dang, g-yon pa rla g-yon pa'i khar bzhag, rkang pa brkyangs bskums ci rigs byas pa sengge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal zhing, thams cad dvangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gnyid bsad res kyis gsal 'debs pa yin la
raw.english: You are lying on your right side, facing west.  Your right hand rests below your right cheek, and your left hand is on the left thigh.  Your legs could either be straight or bent.  Then fall off to sleep this way, in the Lion's Pose.  If ever you wake during the night, visualize that everything around you has the nature of light, pure and crystalline.

raw.acip: BDUD RTZI'I DVANGS MA RNAMS SNYING GAR SANGS RGYAS THAMS CAD KYI NGO BO RJE BTZUN MA'I THUGS DANG RANG SEMS DBYER MED BAm YIG GI RNAM PAR GNAS PA LA THIMS PAS BDE STONG GI RTOGS PA SKYES PAR BSAM LA CUNG ZAD MNYAM PAR 'JOG PA STE,
raw.wylie: bdud rtsi'i dvangs ma rnams snying gar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med baM yig gi rnam par gnas pa la thims pas bde stong gi rtogs pa skyes par bsam la cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa ste
raw.english: The pure essences of the nectar then dissolve into your heart, and due to this, the pure mind of the Holy Angel, whose true nature is that of every Buddha, becomes indivisible with your mind (which appears in the form of a vam syllable at your heart). Then imagine that the realization of bliss and voidness arises within you, and stay fixed in that meditative space for a brief time.

raw.acip: RANG SEMS LHAN CIG SKYES PA GSAL ZHING STONG PA DE GSANG BA'I RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG, DE'I RTEN 'BREL GYIS LTE BA'I DBU MAR RO RKYANG GIS 'KHYUD PA'I NANG GI DBYIBS GRU GSUM AE YIG DANG, DE'I NANG DU KHAMS DMAR PO NYIS DVANGS KYI GSUM DVANGS AA THUNG SHAD KYI RNAM PA TZAN NAM, LUGS 'DIR PHAG MO TI LA KA ZHES PA BAm YIG ZLUM PO'I RNAM PAR YOD PA NI NANG GI RNAL 'BYOR MA DANG,
raw.wylie: rang sems lhan cig skyes pa gsal zhing stong pa de gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma dang, de'i rten 'brel gyis lte ba'i dbu mar ro rkyang gis 'khyud pa'i nang gi dbyibs gru gsum ae yig dang, de'i nang du khams dmar po nyis dvangs kyi gsum dvangs aa thung shad kyi rnam pa tsan nam, lugs 'dir phag mo ti la ka zhes pa baM yig zlum po'i rnam par yod pa ni nang gi rnal 'byor ma dang
raw.english: With the blessing of its presence, then inside the central channel at the navel, where the taste and solitary channels are entwined around it, is an eh letter29 in the shape of a triangle.  Inside of this triangle is the essence of the essence of the red element, refined yet again into pure essence.  It is in the shape of a short ah, which looks like a Tibetan punctuation mark at the end of a line of verse: k30.  In this system it is called the "drop of the Sow," and it takes the form of a rounded v letter31--this is the inner Angel.

raw.acip: LTE BAR MA LAS THOB PA'I KHAMS DMAR PO'I DVANGS MA YOD PA LAS LUS BSKYED CING SPRUL BA DANG, DE NYID BDE BA CHEN PO BSKYED CING SPRUL PA'I GZHI YANG YIN PAS LTE BA SPRUL PA'I 'KHOR LOR SNGAGS 'KHOR PHAB LA RTZE GCIG TU DMIGS PA'I YID BZLAS DANG,
raw.wylie: lte bar ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po'i dvangs ma yod pa las lus bskyed cing sprul ba dang, de nyid bde ba chen po bskyed cing sprul pa'i gzhi yang yin pas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor sngags 'khor phab la rtse gcig tu dmigs pa'i yid bzlas dang
raw.english: Now our body is created or emanated from the purified essence of the red elemental fluid at the navel, which we have received from our mother.  And this element is itself the basis for the creation or emanation of great bliss.  And to this navel chakra of emanation we bring down the circle of secret words, reading them in thought, and staying single-pointedly on our object of focus.

raw.acip: DBU MA KHYAD CHOS GSUM LDAN ZHES BYA BA DRANGS SHING 'DRONGS PA CHU SHING GI SDONG PO LTA BU, GSAL SHING DVANGS PA TIL MAR GYI MAR ME LTA BU, 'JAM ZHING MNYEN PA PADMA'I 'DAB MA LTA BU, DE'I STENG DU DMAR ZHING SNUM PA RGYA SKYEGS KYI KHU BA LTA BU BSNAN PA BZHI LDAN DU BZHED PA'ANG YOD,
raw.wylie: dbu ma khyad chos gsum ldan zhes bya ba drangs shing 'drongs pa chu shing gi sdong po lta bu, gsal shing dvangs pa til mar gyi mar me lta bu, 'jam zhing mnyen pa padma'i 'dab ma lta bu, de'i steng du dmar zhing snum pa rgya skyegs kyi khu ba lta bu bsnan pa bzhi ldan du bzhed pa'ang yod
raw.english: The central channel is said to have three qualities.  It is perfectly straight and runs erect like a rod.  It is clear and translucent like a sesame oil flame.  It is soft and pliable like the petal of a lotus flower.  On top of these some people add a fourth quality--that it is red and glistening like the sap from a red lac plant.

raw.acip: DES NA DANG PO NAS RMI LAM GSAL BA DANG DE MIN KYANG GNAS DBEN PA LA SOGS PA RIG PA DVANGS PA'I RGYU'I KHYAD PAR TSOGS PA'I SKABS DANG, MTSAN MO GCIG GI'ANG THO RANGS LTA BU RIG PA GSAL DUS SU, RMI LAM ZIN PAR SLA'O,,
raw.wylie: des na dang po nas rmi lam gsal ba dang de min kyang gnas dben pa la sogs pa rig pa dvangs pa'i rgyu'i khyad par tshogs pa'i skabs dang, mtshan mo gcig gi'ang tho rangs lta bu rig pa gsal dus su, rmi lam zin par sla'o
raw.english: Given all this, it is easier to maintain recognition in your dreams under the following conditions. First, when your dreams are clearer in the first place. Secondly when, even if they are not normally clear, you have created a situation with all the special conditions that lend a lucid state of mind: staying in an isolated area, and the like. And finally, even with regard to a single night, those periods--such as daybreak--when your mental state is more clear.

raw.acip: DE NI MAN NGAG RNAMS LAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR MGRIN PA DANG, SMIN MTSAMS SU SHES PA GTOD PA DANG, DMIGS YUL 'TSER BA'I RNAM PA CAN SGOM PA DANG, RLUNG SBYOR BYAS NAS RIG PA DVANGS SNYIGS 'BYED PA SOGS YIN NO,,
raw.wylie: de ni man ngag rnams las 'byung ba ltar mgrin pa dang, smin mtshams su shes pa gtod pa dang, dmigs yul 'tsher ba'i rnam pa can sgom pa dang, rlung sbyor byas nas rig pa dvangs snyigs 'byed pa sogs yin no
raw.english: These methods, according to the advices for the practice, include focusing the mind at the throat or spot between the eyebrows; or else meditating upon objects as being very bright and sparkling; or holding the winds in a capsule--which serves to separate lucid from turbid states of mind.

raw.acip: DE'I PHYI'I RTZA 'DAB BRGYAD LA AA KA TZA tA TA PA YA SHA BRGYAD, DE'I PHYI'I RTZA 'DAB NGA DRUG LA K'A LI SO BZHI DANG, DBYANGS BCU DRUG ,AA AI AU AE AO AA: STE DBYANGS THUNG NGU DRUG BCAS RNAMS KHAMS KYI DVANGS MA'I NGO BO MGO GYEN BSTAN, ZHVA KHRID DU AAm: BRIS PA'ANG BAR SKYON DU GSUNGS,
raw.wylie: de'i phyi'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la aa ka tsa Ta ta pa ya sha brgyad, de'i phyi'i rtsa 'dab nga drug la kA li so bzhi dang, dbyangs bcu drug ,aa ai au ae ao aa: ste dbyangs thung ngu drug bcas rnams khams kyi dvangs ma'i ngo bo mgo gyen bstan, zhva khrid du aaM: bris pa'ang bar skyon du gsungs
raw.english: On the eight petals formed by the channels outside this piece are the eight letters ah, ka, cha, ta [retroflex], ta [normal], pa, ya, and sha.  On the 56 petals of the channels outside them are the 34 consonants of the Sanskrit alphabet, the 16 vowels, and the six short vowels of a, i, u, e, o, and ah.  These letters are pointing upright, and their actual nature is the refined essence of the substances.  Our Lama noted that the ah in Shalu's treatise with a small circle over it was again a printing error.

raw.acip: SNANG BA DE BSDUS PA'I RJES SU KOR LE RER THIG LE DKAR PO 'AM, ZLA BA SOGS 'CHAR BA'I DKAR LAM MIN PA'I YID NGOR GANG SNANG THAMS CAD NAM MKHA' GA-YA' DAG 'DRA BA ZHIG LA, ZLA 'OD SHIN TU DVANGS SHING GSAL BA SHAR BA 'DRA BA ZHIG GIS THAMS CAD DU KHYAB PA 'ONG STE, STONG PA DANG, SNANG BA ZHES ZER RO,,
raw.wylie: snang ba de bsdus pa'i rjes su kor le rer thig le dkar po 'am, zla ba sogs 'char ba'i dkar lam min pa'i yid ngor gang snang thams cad nam mkha' ga-ya' dag 'dra ba zhig la, zla 'od shin tu dvangs shing gsal ba shar ba 'dra ba zhig gis thams cad du khyab pa 'ong ste, stong pa dang, snang ba zhes zer ro
raw.english: Once this has withdrawn, you get a vision which is not where you see some discrete sphere of white light, or some object like the moon which is radiant white, but rather the entire expanse of what appears to your mind seems like a crystalline sky, a sky in which crystal, shining moonlight appears and blankets the entire scene.  We call this stage "emptiness," or "illumination."

raw.acip: DES NA 'OD GSAL RLUNG STOBS KYIS ZIN PA MIN PAS, GNYID TING NGE 'DZIN DU SKYED NUS PA LA NI GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL GYI SNGON DU 'CHAR DGOS PA'I STONG PA GSUM SNGAR BSHAD PA DE MI 'CHAR BAS, DE GSUM SNGON DU MI 'CHAR BA'I GNYID KYI TING NGE 'DZIN GSAL DVANGS BYUNG YANG, GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL GYI DON MED DO,,
raw.wylie: des na 'od gsal rlung stobs kyis zin pa min pas, gnyid ting nge 'dzin du skyed nus pa la ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyi sngon du 'char dgos pa'i stong pa gsum sngar bshad pa de mi 'char bas, de gsum sngon du mi 'char ba'i gnyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal dvangs byung yang, gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyi don med do
raw.english: What this all means is that, because he or she has not attained recognition of the clear light by force of their work with their winds, then this individual who is able to maintain meditative concentration in their sleep has not managed to get the three types of emptiness to appear, as we described earlier, first--and the fact is that they must appear prior to the clear light of sleep.  And although it may be true that you can achieve a meditative concentration within your sleep which is extremely lucid even without these three having made their appearance, this is not what the "clear light of sleep" refers to.

raw.acip: DE'I PHYIR GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL LA NYAMS DANG RTOGS PA'I 'OD GSAL GNYIS DANG, SRAB MO DANG 'THUG PO'I 'OD GSAL GNYIS DANG, RMI LAM GYI DUS SU RTOG MED KYI TING NGE 'DZIN GSAL DVANGS BYUNG BA YANG, GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL DU 'JOG PA'I RNAM GZHAG MANG PO SNANG YANG SNGAR BSHAD PA LTAR MA PHYED PAR GNYID TING NGE 'DZIN DU SKYED NUS PA TZAM GYI STENG NAS BSHAD PA MANG DU BYAS PAR SNANG BAS, YID BRTAN THUB PA MI SNANG NGO,,
raw.wylie: de'i phyir gnyid kyi 'od gsal la nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gnyis dang, srab mo dang 'thug po'i 'od gsal gnyis dang, rmi lam gyi dus su rtog med kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal dvangs byung ba yang, gnyid kyi 'od gsal du 'jog pa'i rnam gzhag mang po snang yang sngar bshad pa ltar ma phyed par gnyid ting nge 'dzin du skyed nus pa tsam gyi steng nas bshad pa mang du byas par snang bas, yid brtan thub pa mi snang ngo
raw.english: And so it is that the clear light of sleep can be discussed in terms of the two of a feeling of clear light and an actual experience of clear light; and in terms of the two of a less deep state of clear light and a deeper state of it; and in terms of a clear and lucid state of non-conceptual concentration that comes in your dreams.  And despite the fact that many presentations on the clear light of sleep have been written, a great number of them give their explanation based on nothing more than teaching the ability to turn sleep into a state of meditative concentration, without making any of the distinctions we've just mentioned.  As such it does not appear that we should accept these words as authoritative.

raw.acip: DANG PO NI, ,LTE BA'I RTZA GSUM DBUS GNAS DMAR NAG Rm, ,STENG 'OG RLUNG GIS SBAR PA'I TSANGS PA'I MES, ,STONG PHRAG DON GNYIS SNYIGS MA'I KHAMS BSREGS TE, ,DVANGS MAS DH'U T'I YONGS SU GANG BAR SHOG ,CES PA STE,
raw.wylie: dang po ni, ,lte ba'i rtsa gsum dbus gnas dmar nag rM, ,steng 'og rlung gis sbar pa'i tshangs pa'i mes, ,stong phrag don gnyis snyigs ma'i khams bsregs te, ,dvangs mas dhU tI yongs su gang bar shog ,ces pa ste
raw.english: Here is the first of these steps, found in the lines of verse below: And by this power May the black red ram Staying in the center Of three channels at my navel, This fire of the pure One, Fueled by the upper And lower winds, Burn away the dross In the elements Of the two and seventy thousand, Filling the channel of the dance Completely with The essence purified.

raw.acip: YANG SNGAR BZHIN LAN BDUN TZAM BYAS PAS, STOD KYI KHAMS DVANGS MA THAMS CAD ZHU BA RO RKYANG BRGYUD DBU MAR ZHUGS PAS DBU MA PHAL CHER KHENGS, SMAD KYI KHAMS DVANGS MA RNAMS KYANG RO RKYANG DU ZHUGS SHING RO RKYANG GI MAR SNE DBU MAR BCUG PA NAS DRANGS PAS,
raw.wylie: yang sngar bzhin lan bdun tsam byas pas, stod kyi khams dvangs ma thams cad zhu ba ro rkyang brgyud dbu mar zhugs pas dbu ma phal cher khengs, smad kyi khams dvangs ma rnams kyang ro rkyang du zhugs shing ro rkyang gi mar sne dbu mar bcug pa nas drangs pas
raw.english: Stoke the fire seven more times, as before.  All of the purified essence residing in the upper parts of the body now melts into the channel of taste and the solitary channel.  From there it enters into the central channel, almost filling it. The purified essence in the lower parts of the body also enters into the taste and solitary channels.  From their lower openings, which are inserted into the central channel, it is drawn up into the central channel.

raw.acip: SMIN MTSAMS NAS GSANG GNAS KYI BAR GYI DBU MA'I NANG THAMS CAD KHAMS DKAR PO'I DVANGS MA DNGUL CHU'I MDOG LTA BUS MER GYIS KHENGS PAS BDE BA CHEN PO SKYES, DES YUL STONG PA NYID NGES PAS BDE STONG GI YE SHES SKYES PAR BSAM,
raw.wylie: smin mtshams nas gsang gnas kyi bar gyi dbu ma'i nang thams cad khams dkar po'i dvangs ma dngul chu'i mdog lta bus mer gyis khengs pas bde ba chen po skyes, des yul stong pa nyid nges pas bde stong gi ye shes skyes par bsam
raw.english: Now inside the central channel, from the point between the eyebrows to the secret place, all is filled with the purified white element, glowing like quicksilver, and a feeling of great bliss arises.  You use this bliss to perceive the object of emptiness.  Think then that the wisdom of bliss and voidness has arisen within you.

raw.acip: KHAMS KYI DVANGS MAS DH'U T'I DBU MA GANG BA LA BRTEN NAS BDE STONG GI YE SHES SKYE BAR SHOG CIG, CES SMON PA'O,
raw.wylie: khams kyi dvangs mas dhU tI dbu ma gang ba la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes skye bar shog cig, ces smon pa'o
raw.english: And we are praying here that by the practice of filling the central channel--the channel of dance--with the substances of the essence purified, we may give birth to the wisdom of bliss and emptiness. *  *  *  *  * Here next is the presentation of Pabongka Rinpoche, Dechen Nyingpo:

raw.acip: GTUM MO'I ME CHES CHER 'BAR TE RTZA NANG THAMS CAD LA KHYAB PAS KHAMS KYI SNYIGS MA BSREGS LA DVANGS MAS GANG BA'I BDE CHEN GYIS STONG NYID DRAN PA'I BDE STONG LA 'JOG ,
raw.wylie: gtum mo'i me ches cher 'bar te rtsa nang thams cad la khyab pas khams kyi snyigs ma bsregs la dvangs mas gang ba'i bde chen gyis stong nyid dran pa'i bde stong la 'jog
raw.english: As a result the inner fire blazes with fierce intensity, and spreads all throughout the inside of the channels.  This burns all the dregs in the channels, and fills the channels with refined nectar.  This brings on a great bliss that leads one to think of voidness, and so the mind stays fixed on bliss and voidness together. *Translator's note: The Tibetan editor notes a possible problem with the text here.

raw.acip: SBOM PHRA GRO SOG TZAM DBU MA LA REG LA MA 'BYAR BA'I TSUL GYI MAR SNE DBU MA DANG MNYAM ZHING , YAR STE SNA BUG G-YAS G-YON DU SNGAR BZHIN ZUG PA DVANGS SENG NGE BA,
raw.wylie: sbom phra gro sog tsam dbu ma la reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul gyi mar sne dbu ma dang mnyam zhing , yar ste sna bug g-yas g-yon du sngar bzhin zug pa dvangs seng nge ba
raw.english: Their width is about that of a wheat or hay stalk.  They run alongside the central channel, touching it but not attached to it.  Their bottom tips extend to the same level as that of the central channel; their upper tips penetrate to the area of the right and left nostrils, as described earlier.  They are clear and bright in appearance.

raw.acip: YANG SNGAR LTAR BZUNG BAS STOD KYI KHAMS DVANGS MA RNAMS KYIS RO RKYANG KHENGS PA DBU MA'I NANG DU ZHUGS PAS DBU MA PHAL CHER KHENGS,
raw.wylie: yang sngar ltar bzung bas stod kyi khams dvangs ma rnams kyis ro rkyang khengs pa dbu ma'i nang du zhugs pas dbu ma phal cher khengs
raw.english: The next step is to take a retention, as before, and watch as the purified essence of the substances within the channels of the upper part of the body come and fill the channel of taste, and the solitary channel.  They then flow into the central channel and fill most of it.

raw.acip: SMAD KYI KHAMS DVANGS MA RNAMS KYANG RO RKYANG GNYIS SU ZHUGS NAS RO RKYANG GNYIS KYI MAR SNE DBU MA'I NANG DU BCUG NAS KHAMS THAMS CAD DBU MAR ZHUGS PAS DBU MA SMIN MTSAMS NAS BHA GA'I BA'I BAR KHAMS DVANGS MA DNGUL CHU LTA BUS MER GYIS KHENGS PA SRAN MA TZAM RE RES KYANG BDE STONG DBYER MED KYI YE SHES SKYE NUS PAR BSAM LA LAN BDUN SOGS BYA'O,,
raw.wylie: smad kyi khams dvangs ma rnams kyang ro rkyang gnyis su zhugs nas ro rkyang gnyis kyi mar sne dbu ma'i nang du bcug nas khams thams cad dbu mar zhugs pas dbu ma smin mtshams nas bha ga'i ba'i bar khams dvangs ma dngul chu lta bus mer gyis khengs pa sran ma tsam re res kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes skye nus par bsam la lan bdun sogs bya'o
raw.english: Now the purified essence of the substances in the channels of the lower part of the body too enters these two channels--that of taste, and the solitary one.  You have inserted the lower tips of these two channels into the central channel; watch now as all the substances flow into the central channel, filling it from the point between the eyebrows on down to the bhaga with a pure liquid substance shining like quicksilver.  Every single pea-sized drop of this moonsilver would be enough to bring on the wisdom of indivisible bliss and voidness.  Repeat this again for a total of seven times, or however many you've been doing.

raw.acip: SNANG BA DE BSDUS PA'I RJES SU KOR LE RER THIG LE DKAR PO 'AM, ZLA BA SOGS 'CHAR BA'I DKAR LAM MIN PA'I YID NGOR GANG SNANG THAMS CAD NAM MKHA' GA-YA' DAG 'DRA BA ZHIG LA, ZLA 'OD SHIN TU DVANGS SHING GSAL BA SHAR BA 'DRA BA ZHIG GIS THAMS CAD DU KHYAB PA 'ONG STE, STONG PA DANG, SNANG BA ZHES ZER RO,,
raw.wylie: snang ba de bsdus pa'i rjes su kor le rer thig le dkar po 'am, zla ba sogs 'char ba'i dkar lam min pa'i yid ngor gang snang thams cad nam mkha' ga-ya' dag 'dra ba zhig la, zla 'od shin tu dvangs shing gsal ba shar ba 'dra ba zhig gis thams cad du khyab pa 'ong ste, stong pa dang, snang ba zhes zer ro
raw.english: Once this has withdrawn, you get a vision which is not where you see some discrete sphere of white light, or some object like the moon which is radiant white, but rather the entire expanse of what appears to your mind seems like a crystalline sky, a sky in which crystal, shining moonlight appears and blankets the entire scene.  We call this stage "emptiness," or "illumination."

raw.acip: DES NA 'OD GSAL RLUNG STOBS KYIS ZIN PA MIN PAS, GNYID TING NGE 'DZIN DU SKYED NUS PA LA NI GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL GYI SNGON DU 'CHAR DGOS PA'I STONG PA GSUM SNGAR BSHAD PA DE MI 'CHAR BAS, DE GSUM SNGON DU MI 'CHAR BA'I GNYID KYI TING NGE 'DZIN GSAL DVANGS BYUNG YANG, GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL GYI DON MED DO,,
raw.wylie: des na 'od gsal rlung stobs kyis zin pa min pas, gnyid ting nge 'dzin du skyed nus pa la ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyi sngon du 'char dgos pa'i stong pa gsum sngar bshad pa de mi 'char bas, de gsum sngon du mi 'char ba'i gnyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal dvangs byung yang, gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyi don med do
raw.english: What this all means is that, because he or she has not attained recognition of the clear light by force of their work with their winds, then this individual who is able to maintain meditative concentration in their sleep has not managed to get the three types of emptiness to appear, as we described earlier, first--and the fact is that they must appear prior to the clear light of sleep.  And although it may be true that you can achieve a meditative concentration within your sleep which is extremely lucid even without these three having made their appearance, this is not what the "clear light of sleep" refers to.

raw.acip: DE'I PHYIR GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL LA NYAMS DANG RTOGS PA'I 'OD GSAL GNYIS DANG, SRAB MO DANG 'THUG PO'I 'OD GSAL GNYIS DANG, RMI LAM GYI DUS SU RTOG MED KYI TING NGE 'DZIN GSAL DVANGS BYUNG BA YANG, GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL DU 'JOG PA'I RNAM GZHAG MANG PO SNANG YANG SNGAR BSHAD PA LTAR MA PHYED PAR GNYID TING NGE 'DZIN DU SKYED NUS PA TZAM GYI STENG NAS BSHAD PA MANG DU BYAS PAR SNANG BAS, YID BRTAN THUB PA MI SNANG NGO,,
raw.wylie: de'i phyir gnyid kyi 'od gsal la nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gnyis dang, srab mo dang 'thug po'i 'od gsal gnyis dang, rmi lam gyi dus su rtog med kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal dvangs byung ba yang, gnyid kyi 'od gsal du 'jog pa'i rnam gzhag mang po snang yang sngar bshad pa ltar ma phyed par gnyid ting nge 'dzin du skyed nus pa tsam gyi steng nas bshad pa mang du byas par snang bas, yid brtan thub pa mi snang ngo
raw.english: And so it is that the clear light of sleep can be discussed in terms of the two of a feeling of clear light and an actual experience of clear light; and in terms of the two of a less deep state of clear light and a deeper state of it; and in terms of a clear and lucid state of non-conceptual concentration that comes in your dreams.  And despite the fact that many presentations on the clear light of sleep have been written, a great number of them give their explanation based on nothing more than teaching the ability to turn sleep into a state of meditative concentration, without making any of the distinctions we've just mentioned.  As such it does not appear that we should accept these words as authoritative.

raw.acip: DE DUS SNYUN DVANGS SKABS 'JAM DBYANGS GZI BRJID RMAD DU BYUNG BA GCIG GI ZHAL NAS DA PHYIN CHAD BSKYED RDZOGS KYI THUGS NYAMS SU BZHES PA LA 'GRUS PAR MDZAD NA SNGAGS BLA MED KYI RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN MYUR DU 'KHRUNGS SHING, SLOB MA SKAL LDAN BDUN LA YANG LAM GYI RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN RE SKYE BAR 'GYUR GSUNGS,
raw.wylie: de dus snyun dvangs skabs 'jam dbyangs gzi brjid rmad du byung ba gcig gi zhal nas da phyin chad bskyed rdzogs kyi thugs nyams su bzhes pa la 'grus par mdzad na sngags bla med kyi rtogs pa khyad par can myur du 'khrungs shing, slob ma skal ldan bdun la yang lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can re skye bar 'gyur gsungs
raw.english: [Scene number] 132B: During this time--at a point where he is recovering from his illness--a majestic form of Gentle Voice appears to Je Rinpoche.  He tells the Lord, "From this point on, you must throw yourself into practicing the stages of creation and completion.  If you do so, then you will quickly give birth to high realizations of the unsurpassed teachings of the secret word.  Seven of your disciples--those with the fortune that comes from good deeds--will as well achieve extraordinary realizations of the path."

raw.acip: SKU KHAMS BSNYEL PA CUNG ZAD DVANGS PA'I SKABS SHIG TU, RJE BTZUN 'JAM PA'I DBYANGS KYI ZHAL NAS,
raw.wylie: sku khams bsnyel pa cung zad dvangs pa'i skabs shig tu, rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas
raw.english: At one point Je Tsongkapa became ill; as He began to get better, the holy Gentle Voice came to Him and said the following, telling Him of things to come--

raw.acip: DE NAS BSNYUN LEGS PAR DVANGS,
raw.wylie: de nas bsnyun legs par dvangs
raw.english: Shortly after this, His illness went away, completely. * * * One of the most comprehensive presentations of Je Tsongkapa's life is The Great Biography of Gyalwang Lobsang Trinley Namgyal (fl. 1850), who also composed a number of the textbooks used at the matchless Sera Mey Tibetan Monastery.  His work has the longer title of The String of Incredible Jewels, the One Highest Gem that Adorns the Teachings of the Able Buddhas: A Spiritual Biography of Tsongkapa the Great, the King of the Dharma (ACIP digital text S00191; selections below found on pp. 377-380).  It repeats almost word-for-word the accounts given above; as such, we will list here only some additional comments made about them--

raw.acip: 'DI BYUNG BA'I DUS NI RNAM THAR GZHAN RNAMS SU SNYUN CUNG ZAD DVANGS PA'I DUS ZHES PA LAS GSAL CHA MI 'DUG KYANG, PAn CHEN BLO GROS LEGS BZANG GIS MDZAD PA'I GSANG RNAM DU, SHING RTA LO ZLA BA DANG PO'I NANG YIN PAR GSUNGS 'DUG ,
raw.wylie: 'di byung ba'i dus ni rnam thar gzhan rnams su snyun cung zad dvangs pa'i dus zhes pa las gsal cha mi 'dug kyang, paN chen blo gros legs bzang gis mdzad pa'i gsang rnam du, shing rta lo zla ba dang po'i nang yin par gsungs 'dug
raw.english: Concerning the exact dating of these events, the other biographies only say that they happened "at a time when Je Tsongkapa had somewhat recovered from an illness," and nothing more precise than this.  The secret biography composed by Panchen Lodru Leksang though states that these incidents took place in the first month of the Wood Horse Year [1414]. ....

raw.acip: RTOGS LDAN PA'I MNAL LAM LA, RJE RIN PO CHE'I MCHOD RTEN YIN ZER BA CHA TSAD YONGS SU RDZOGS PA RTZE MO SPRIN GYI SEB LA SLEB PA, KHA DOG SHIN TU DKAR ZHING 'KHREGS PA KAR YOL GYI RTZI LTAR DVANGS PA ZHIG LA,
raw.wylie: rtogs ldan pa'i mnal lam la, rje rin po che'i mchod rten yin zer ba cha tshad yongs su rdzogs pa rtse mo sprin gyi seb la sleb pa, kha dog shin tu dkar zhing 'khregs pa kar yol gyi rtsi ltar dvangs pa zhig la
raw.english: Tokdenpa in His dream saw an offering shrine that people were saying was Je Tsongkapa's.  It was complete in all the proper dimensions, and its tip reached into the clouds.  Its surface was a very pure white, and it was hard and strong--very clear, as though a coating of ceramic had been placed upon it.

raw.acip: ,,DGUNG LO NGA BRGYAD PA'I SHING RTA LO'I DPYID SKU KHAMS BSNYEL BA CUNG ZAD DVANGS PA'I SKABS SHIG TU RJE BTZUN 'JAM PA'I DBYANGS KYI ZHAL NAS,
raw.wylie: dgung lo nga brgyad pa'i shing rta lo'i dpyid sku khams bsnyel ba cung zad dvangs pa'i skabs shig tu rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas
raw.english: In his 58th year*, in the spring of the Wooden Horse year--at a time when Je Tsongkapa was just recovering somewhat from an illness of His holy body--the Master had a visitation from the Holy One, Gentle Voice. *Translator's note: Remember that time in the womb is often counted in the Tibetan reckoning of ages. Chahar Geshe then repeats verbatim the conversation between Je Rinpoche and Manjushri, continuing with:

raw.acip: RJE RIN PO CHE SKU KHAMS BSNYEL BA DVANGS SKABS SHIG ,RJE BTZUN GYI ZHAL GZIGS PAS, DA PHYIN CHED BSKYED RDZOGS KYI RNAL 'BYOR LA 'BAD NA RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN SKYE, SLOB MA SKAL LDAN BDUN LA'ANG RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN SKYE'O GSUNGS PA LA,
raw.wylie: rje rin po che sku khams bsnyel ba dvangs skabs shig ,rje btsun gyi zhal gzigs pas, da phyin ched bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la 'bad na rtogs pa khyad par can skye, slob ma skal ldan bdun la'ang rtogs pa khyad par can skye'o gsungs pa la
raw.english: There was a certain point in His life when Je Rinpoche was recovering from an illness.  He had a vision of the Holy One, Gentle Voice, in which the Angel told Him: "If from this point in your life on you concentrate on the deep practices of the stages of creation and completion, then extraordinary realizations will come to you.  They will also come to seven of your disciples who possess great goodness."

raw.acip: RJE RIN PO CHE SKU KHAMS BSNYEL BA DVANGS SKABS SHIG ,RJE BTZUN GYI ZHAL GZIGS PAS, DA PHYIN CHAD BSKYED RDZOGS KYI RNAL 'BYOR LA 'BAD NA RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN SKYE, SLOB MA SKAL LDAN BDUN LA'ANG RTOGS PA KHYAD PAR CAN SKYE'O GSUNGS PA LA,
raw.wylie: rje rin po che sku khams bsnyel ba dvangs skabs shig ,rje btsun gyi zhal gzigs pas, da phyin chad bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la 'bad na rtogs pa khyad par can skye, slob ma skal ldan bdun la'ang rtogs pa khyad par can skye'o gsungs pa la
raw.english: There was a certain point in His life when Je Rinpoche was recovering from an illness.  He had a vision of the Holy One, Gentle Voice, in which the Angel told Him: "If from this point in your life on you concentrate on the deep practices of the stages of creation and completion, then extraordinary realizations will come to you.  They will also come to seven of your disciples who possess great goodness."

raw.acip: ,PHYI NANG CHOS RNAMS SGYU MA RMI LAM DANG, ,DVANGS PA'I MTSO NANG ZLA GZUGS JI BZHIN DU, ,SNANG YANG BDEN PAR MED PA'I TSUL RTOGS NAS, ,SGYU MA'I TING 'DZIN RDZOGS PAR BYIN GYIS RLOBS,
raw.wylie: phyi nang chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam dang, ,dvangs pa'i mtsho nang zla gzugs ji bzhin du, ,snang yang bden par med pa'i tshul rtogs nas, ,sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs
raw.english: Bless me to master That single-pointed meditation Upon the illusion, Where I realize How things can appear, And yet still not be real: How all things, both outer and inner, Are like an illusion, a dream-- Like a moon that floats Upon a crystal lake.

raw.acip: NAM MKHA' DANG RLUNG DVANGS PAR BYED CING SA CHU SDUD PA DANG RGYAS PAR BYED PAS YANG BA DANG,
raw.wylie: nam mkha' dang rlung dvangs par byed cing sa chu sdud pa dang rgyas par byed pas yang ba dang
raw.english: 2) He is light—in the sense of ephemeral—because he makes the sky and wind invisible, and causes earth and water to collect together, and then spreads them across the world.

raw.acip: RO LA DBYE NA DRUG YOD DE, MNGAR BA DANG SKYUR BA, KHA BA DANG BSKA BA, TSVA BA DANG LAN TSVA BA DRUG YOD PA'I PHYIR,
raw.wylie: ro la dbye na drug yod de, mngar ba dang skyur ba, kha ba dang bska ba, tshva ba dang lan tshva ba drug yod pa'i phyir
raw.english: Taste may be divided into six types: sweet and sour; bitter and astringent; spicy and salty.

raw.acip: MNGAR BA BZHAG TU YOD DE, BU RAM GYI RO DANG, 'O MA'I RO LTA BU DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
raw.wylie: mngar ba bzhag tu yod de, bu ram gyi ro dang, 'o ma'i ro lta bu de yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: We can posit examples of things which are sweet; for the taste of brown sugar, and the taste of milk, are two such examples.

raw.acip: MIG GI DBANG PO'I MTSAN NYID YOD DE, RANG 'BRAS MIG SHES KYI THUN MONG MIN PA'I BDAG RKYEN BYED PA'I CHA NAS BZHAG PA'I NANG GI GZUGS CAN DVANGS PA DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
raw.wylie: mig gi dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de, rang 'bras mig shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i nang gi gzugs can dvangs pa de yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: There is a definition of the sense of sight, because “that inner form which is clear and which is established as what it is by serving as the unique trigger, subsumed within a person, for the consciousness of the eye which results from it” is that definition.

raw.acip: RNA BA'I DBANG PO'I MTSAN NYID YOD DE, RANG 'BRAS RNA SHES KYI THUN MONG MIN PA'I BDAG RKYEN BYED PA'I CHA NAS BZHAG PA'I NANG GI GZUGS CAN DVANGS PA DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
raw.wylie: rna ba'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de, rang 'bras rna shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i nang gi gzugs can dvangs pa de yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: There is a definition of the sense of hearing, because “that inner form which is clear and which is established as what it is by serving as the unique trigger, subsumed within a person, for the consciousness of the ear which results from it” is this definition.

raw.acip: SNA'I DBANG PO'I MTSAN NYID YOD DE, RANG 'BRAS SNA SHES KYI THUN MONG MIN PA'I BDAG RKYEN BYED PA'I CHA NAS BZHAG PA'I NANG GI GZUGS CAN DVANGS PA DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
raw.wylie: sna'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de, rang 'bras sna shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i nang gi gzugs can dvangs pa de yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: There is a definition of the sense of smell, because “that inner form which is clear and which is established as what it is by serving as the unique trigger, subsumed within a person, for the consciousness of the nose which results from it” is that definition.

raw.acip: LCE'I DBANG PO'I MTSAN NYID YOD DE, RANG 'BRAS LCE SHES KYI THUN MONG MIN PA'I BDAG RKYEN BYED PA'I CHA NAS BZHAG PA'I NANG GI GZUGS CAN DVANGS PA DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
raw.wylie: lce'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de, rang 'bras lce shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i nang gi gzugs can dvangs pa de yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: There is a definition of the sense of taste, because “that inner form which is clear and which is established as what it is by serving as the unique trigger, subsumed within a person, for the consciousness of the tongue which results from it” is that definition.

raw.acip: LUS KYI DBANG PO'I MTSAN NYID YOD DE, RANG 'BRAS LUS SHES KYI THUN MONG MIN PA'I BDAG RKYEN BYED PA'I CHA NAS BZHAG PA'I NANG GI GZUGS CAN DVANGS PA DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
raw.wylie: lus kyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de, rang 'bras lus shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i nang gi gzugs can dvangs pa de yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: There is a definition of the sense of touch, because “that inner form which is clear and which is established as what it is by serving as the unique trigger, subsumed within a person, for the consciousness of the body which results from it” is this definition.

raw.acip: 'DI LTAR CHU SHIN TU DVANGS PA RLUNG SHIN TU DRAG PO MIN PAS, CHU'I CHA SHAS BRLABS PAS KHYAB PA'I NANG DU ZLA BA'I GZUGS BRNYAN,
raw.wylie: 'di ltar chu shin tu dvangs pa rlung shin tu drag po min pas, chu'i cha shas brlabs pas khyab pa'i nang du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan
raw.english: The picture here is of a crystal-clear body of water covered by ripples created by currents of a wind which is not particularly strong; and in a certain part of the water's surface we see a reflection of the moon.

raw.acip: MI RNAMS KYIS NI MNGAR BA DANG DVANGS PA DANG BSIL BA'I CHUR RTOG CING KHRUS BYED DO, ,'THUNG NGO DER 'JUG GO ,NAM MKHA' MTHA' YAS SKYE MCHED LA SNYOMS PAR ZHUGS PA'I LHA RNAMS KYIS NI NAM MKHAR MTHONG STE, GZUGS KYI 'DU SHES RNAM PAR BSHIG PA'I PHYIR RO ZHES BSHAD DO,,
raw.wylie: mi rnams kyis ni mngar ba dang dvangs pa dang bsil ba'i chur rtog cing khrus byed do, ,'thung ngo der 'jug go ,nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par zhugs pa'i lha rnams kyis ni nam mkhar mthong ste, gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bshig pa'i phyir ro zhes bshad do
raw.english: Human beings perceive it as water which is sweet and clear and cool, and relate to it by saying, “I'll take a bath in it,” or “I'll take a drink from it.” Those worldly gods who are deep in meditation upon the absorption known as “Limitless Space” see the same thing as empty space, for their conception of it as form has dissolved completely.

raw.acip: GSAL CHA DANG DVANGS CHA NI YUL LA MI BYED PAR, YUL CAN SHES PA LA GSAL CHA'AM DVANGS CHA YOD MED LA BYA DGOS, GSAL CHA MI 'BYUNG BA'I TSE SGRIB BYED KYIS SGRIB PA LTAR YOD,
raw.wylie: gsal cha dang dvangs cha ni yul la mi byed par, yul can shes pa la gsal cha'am dvangs cha yod med la bya dgos, gsal cha mi 'byung ba'i tshe sgrib byed kyis sgrib pa ltar yod
raw.english: It's important to say here that—when we talk about clarity, or clearness—we're not talking about a quality of the object. Rather, it's a distinction that you have to make about the subject state of mind in meditation: does the mind itself feel clear—is there mental clarity, or not? When we can't get clarity to come, it feels almost like we've moved under a dark shadow.

raw.acip: DE BLANGS NA 'KHOR BA 'DIR MTHO DMA' GANG 'DRA ZHIG TU SKYE BA BLANGS KYANG SDUG BSNGAL, GSUM GYIS GO MTSAMS MED PAR MNGAR BA LAS BDE BA'I SKABS CUNG ZAD KYANG MI 'BYUNG BAS GNAS GANG DU PHYIN KYANG SDUG BSNGAL GYI GNAS GROGS SU DANG 'GROGS KYANG SDUG BSNGAL GYI GROGS LONGS SPYOD GANG LA LONGS SPYAD KYANG SDUG BSNGAL GYI LONGS SPYOD KHO NA LAS MA 'DAS
raw.wylie: de blangs na 'khor ba 'dir mtho dma' gang 'dra zhig tu skye ba blangs kyang sdug bsngal, gsum gyis go mtshams med par mngar ba las bde ba'i skabs cung zad kyang mi 'byung bas gnas gang du phyin kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas grogs su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs longs spyod gang la longs spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod kho na las ma 'das
raw.english: Once we have taken a birth in the cycle, we'll find ourselves tormented by the three different kinds of suffering, without the slightest break. It doesn't matter at all whether we take a higher birth or a lower one; there exists no such thing as a pleasant moment here. Whatever place we go is a place that brings us pain. Whatever friend we go with is a friend who brings us pain. Whatever possession we have is a possession which brings us pain. They cannot and will not ever be anything else.

raw.acip: MI RNAMS KYIS NI MNGAR BA DANG DWANGS PA DANG BSIL BA'I CHUR RTOGS SHING, 'THUNG NGO KHRUS BYED DO DER 'JUG GO
raw.wylie: mi rnams kyis ni mngar ba dang dwangs pa dang bsil ba'i chur rtogs shing, 'thung ngo khrus byed do der 'jug go
raw.english: Humans look at the same thing and perceive it as water—sweet, clear, and cool. They drink of it, they wash themselves with it, and they swim in it.

raw.acip: DANG POR GANG DU GNAS PA DE YANG 'GRO BA GSUM PO DE'I RANG RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN, PA'I LAS LA BRTEN NAS GRUB PA'I SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN GANG NAS BLANGS PA DE NYID DU GRUB PA YIN TE MI'I THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS LA BRTEN NAS GRUB PAS MI'I 'JIG RTEN GYI CHU DWANGS SHING BSIL BA NAS BLANGS NA DE NYID DU GNAS PA SOGS YIN PA'I PHYIR
raw.wylie: dang por gang du gnas pa de yang 'gro ba gsum po de'i rang rang gi thun mong ma yin, pa'i las la brten nas grub pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten gang nas blangs pa de nyid du grub pa yin te mi'i thun mong ma yin pa'i las la brten nas grub pas mi'i 'jig rten gyi chu dwangs shing bsil ba nas blangs na de nyid du gnas pa sogs yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: How the glass of liquid exists originally all depends on the particular outer world from where it has been taken, for each of the three different beings has a different outer world, depending on the specific karma he himself has collected. If the glass of liquid were sweet, cool water taken from the world of humans—a world created by the specific karma of the human in the group—then that would be its original condition, and so on.

raw.acip: YI DWAGS KYIS CHU KLUNG LA BLTAS PA NA RNAG KHRAG MTHONG BA DE YANG YI DWAGS 'GA', ZHIG LA YIN GYI YI DWAGS THAMS CAD LA MA YIN TE YI DWAGS LA PHYI'I SGRIB PA CAN NANG GI SGRIB PA CAN ZAS SKOM NYID LA YOD PA'I SGRIB PA CAN DU MA YOD PA'I PHYIR
raw.wylie: yi dwags kyis chu klung la bltas pa na rnag khrag mthong ba de yang yi dwags 'ga', zhig la yin gyi yi dwags thams cad la ma yin te yi dwags la phyi'i sgrib pa can nang gi sgrib pa can zas skom nyid la yod pa'i sgrib pa can du ma yod pa'i phyir
raw.english: When we say that a craving spirit looks at a stream of water and sees pus and blood, by the way, we are only talking about some kinds of craving spirits, and not all of them. This is because there are many kinds of craving spirits: some with obstacles in the world around them that prevent them from relieving their craving; some with obstacles that are parts of their bodies; and some with obstacles that relate to the food or drink itself.

raw.acip: SOS KA'I DUS SU ZLA BA'I REG BYA'I CHA SHAS GCIG GIS NYER LEN DANG YI DWAGS KYI, LAS KYIS LHAN CIG BYED RKYEN BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS DE'I LUS SHES KYI MYONG BYAR GYUR PA'I TSA BA'I REG BYA SKYE BA DANG DGUN DUS SU NYI MA'I REG BYA'I CHA SHAS GCIG GIS NYER LEN DANG YI DWAGS KYI LAS KYIS LHAN CIG BYED RKYEN BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS DE'I LUS SHES KYI MYONG BYAR GYUR PA'I GRANG BA'I REG BYA SKYE BA YOD PA LTA BU YIN PA'I PHYIR
raw.wylie: sos ka'i dus su zla ba'i reg bya'i cha shas gcig gis nyer len dang yi dwags kyi, las kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa la brten nas de'i lus shes kyi myong byar gyur pa'i tsha ba'i reg bya skye ba dang dgun dus su nyi ma'i reg bya'i cha shas gcig gis nyer len dang yi dwags kyi las kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa la brten nas de'i lus shes kyi myong byar gyur pa'i grang ba'i reg bya skye ba yod pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: Another example would be the moon in springtime; one part of the feel of its rays on the body provides the material cause, and then the karma of a craving spirit provides a contributing factor. Based on these two, the spirit gets a sensation of heat, which is experienced by the consciousness of the body. So too with the wintertime sun; one part of the feel of its rays on the body provides the material cause, and then the karma of the craving spirit provides a contributing factor. Based on these two, the spirit gets a sensation cold, which is experienced by the consciousness of the body.

raw.acip: RNAG LA SOGS PA'I DNGOS PO GSUM PO DE SPYIR GO SA 'GOG NUS KYI DNGOS PO YIN, KYANG DE LTAR BLTAS PA DE'I TSE NA GO SA 'GOG BYED KYI DNGOS PO MA YIN PA MI 'GAL TE RI RAB GRU BZHI DANG ZLUM PO LA SOGS PA PHAN TSUN GO SA 'GOG NUS KYI DNGOS PO YIN KYANG RI RAB GCIG GI GO SA NA DE GNYIS KA YOD PA SRID PA LTA BU YIN PA'I PHYIR LCAGS GONG DMAR 'BAR BA TSA BA YIN KYANG LCAGS SNGAGS BTAB PA'I LAG PAS REG PA'I TSE DE'I MYONG BYAR GYUR PA'I REG BYA DE TSA BA'I REG BYA MA YIN TE TSA BA MA YIN PA'I REG BYA YIN PA'I PHYIR
raw.wylie: rnag la sogs pa'i dngos po gsum po de spyir go sa 'gog nus kyi dngos po yin, kyang de ltar bltas pa de'i tshe na go sa 'gog byed kyi dngos po ma yin pa mi 'gal te ri rab gru bzhi dang zlum po la sogs pa phan tshun go sa 'gog nus kyi dngos po yin kyang ri rab gcig gi go sa na de gnyis ka yod pa srid pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir lcags gong dmar 'bar ba tsha ba yin kyang lcags sngags btab pa'i lag pas reg pa'i tshe de'i myong byar gyur pa'i reg bya de tsha ba'i reg bya ma yin te tsha ba ma yin pa'i reg bya yin pa'i phyir
raw.english: Generally speaking, each of the three objects mentioned—the pus and the other two—are things of the type that block other objects from entering into the space which they themselves occupy. It is no contradiction though to say that, in this situation where the beings are looking this way, they are not objects such that they block other things from entering into the space they occupy. This is true for the following reason. A central mountain of the world which is square in shape, and a central mountain of the world which is round in shape, and the like, are objects such that they block other things from entering the space they occupy. Nevertheless, it is possible for both these things to occupy the space taken up by a single central mountain of the world. A red-hot ball of steel is something that's hot, but consider what happens when a person touches it after he has used the mantra of steel on his hand. The sensation that he feels is not a sensation of heat; on the contrary, it is a sensation of something not heat. [This concludes the section of the text entitled "The Stream."] The Asian Classics Institute Reading Three: Emptiness and Paradise; Emptiness and Purification The root text is An Exalted Sutra of the Greater Way on the Perfection of Wisdom, entitled The Diamond Cutter, and is found in bold in the translation and is marked with an ornament in the Tibetan. The commentary is by Choney Lama Drakpa Shedrup (1675-1748) of Sera Mey Tibetan Monastery.
